This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. The [[humanoid]] species was distinguished by their [[Color|blue]] upper faces. One member of this species was a member of the [[Jedi Order]], though they were killed by members of the [[501st Legion]] during [[Operation: Knightfall|the attack on the Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species made the [[Part I|first episode]] of the [[2022]] televisions series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'']], directed by [[Deborah Chow]].<ref name="Obi-Wan Kenobi" />
